response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP, but lacks clear evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct experience with vector databases or RAG architectures, and leadership in customer-facing technical discovery — key requirements for this staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Experienced in AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
Proven full-stack versatility across TypeScript, cloud (AWS), and distributed systems
Active open-source contributor with demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring
concerns: No explicit mention of vector databases, RAG, or LLM optimization in work history
Lacks documented experience leading technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers
AI/ML experience appears incidental rather than core focus over 8+ years
